name: Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal
definition: A hybrid ray marching technique that traverses a voxel grid to find particle hits, using a low-resolution grid for culling and a high-resolution grid for precise hit testing.
summary: Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal is a hybrid technique using a two-tier grid hierarchy to optimize sparse particle searches by culling empty regions with a low-resolution grid before precise high-resolution hit testing.
